We've introduced a new home for all the ways to customize Cursor.
我们为所有自定义 Cursor 的方式提供了新入口。
Add plugins to this marketplace so your team can install them.
向此市场添加插件，供团队成员安装。
This marketplace will be removed from your account. The source repository won't be affected.
此市场将从你的账户中移除，源仓库不受影响。
Remove an installed plugin. Type a search query after the command to find plugins to uninstall.
移除已安装的插件。在命令后输入搜索词以查找要卸载的插件。
Let any team member publish plugins to this marketplace. When off, only team admins can publish.
允许任意团队成员向此市场发布插件。关闭后仅团队管理员可发布。
Browse and install plugins from the Cursor marketplace. Type a search query after the command to find plugins.
从 Cursor 市场浏览并安装插件。在命令后输入搜索词以查找插件。
The plugins you're removing from the marketplace will no longer be available to users and Cloud Agents that rely on them.
你从市场移除的插件将不再对依赖它们的用户和云端 Agent 可用。
Local self-driving could not be started for this task. Try again from the agent panel.
无法为此任务启动本地自动驾驶。请从 Agent 面板重试。
This task does not have an active agent run yet. Start self-driving on the pull request or wait for triage to finish.
此任务尚无进行中的 Agent 运行。请在拉取请求上启动自动驾驶，或等待分诊完成。
Used when Self-driving starts automatically from account defaults.
当自动驾驶按账户默认设置自动启动时使用。
Cloud automations run agents from a variety of environment triggers or on a scheduled basis
云端自动化可通过多种环境触发器或定时计划运行 Agent
Show an expandable Project pill for Tasks, Working, and pull requests

在辅助侧栏中将侧边对话、画布和桌面显示为分区

Open Task and subagent threads in a pane beside the project coordinator. When off, open them as tabs in the current pane. Option-click or Cmd-click always opens in a split.
在项目协调器旁的窗格中打开任务与子 Agent 线程。关闭后，在当前窗格以标签页打开。Option/Cmd-点击始终分屏打开。
Automatically resume the Project coordinator when a thread completes

Hooks run custom scripts at lifecycle events to observe, control, and extend the agent loop.
钩子在生命周期事件运行自定义脚本，用于观察、控制并扩展 Agent 循环。
Skills are specialized capabilities that help the agent accomplish specific tasks. Skills will be invoked by the agent when relevant or can be triggered manually with / in chat.
技能是帮助 Agent 完成特定任务的专用能力。相关时由 Agent 自动调用，也可在对话中用 / 手动触发。
Commands are reusable prompts you invoke with /name to standardize common workflows across your team.
命令是可用 /名称 调用的可复用提示词，用于在团队中标准化常见工作流。
Enable language server by default to provide code intelligence in agent worktree workspaces
默认启用语言服务器，以便在 Agent 工作树工作区提供代码智能
Maximum number of Cursor-managed worktrees to keep across all workspaces. Older worktrees are removed first. Default is 25.
跨所有工作区保留的 Cursor 管理工作树上限。较旧的工作树会优先移除。默认 25。
为工作树启用语言服务器

创建专门的 Agent 以处理聚焦任务

将 Cursor 规则和命令迁移到 Agent 技能。

当 Agent 完成或需要关注时播放提示音
What sending a message while Agent is running does
Agent 运行时发送消息的行为
All MCP servers from this plugin are already added.
此插件的所有 MCP 服务器均已添加。
New messages now steer Agent instead of interrupting
新消息现在会引导 Agent，而不再打断它
Turn a recorded demonstration into a reusable skill.
将录制的演示转换为可复用技能。
Coordinate long-horizon tasks with delegated subagents
通过委派子 Agent 协调长周期任务
Choose team Named Agents to show in your Glass sidebar.
选择要显示在 Glass 侧栏中的团队 Named Agent。
Trigger an agent to run based on a trigger or schedule.
根据触发条件或计划运行 Agent。
Cloud Agents require a Git repository in an open folder.
云端 Agent 需要在已打开的文件夹中有 Git 仓库。
Create or select an agent first, then retry this action.
请先创建或选择一个 Agent，然后重试此操作。
Scheduled tasks run on this machine while Cursor is open
计划任务在 Cursor 打开时于本机运行

浏览市场或导入自定义插件以扩展功能
Hooks that run during the agent's loop will show up here.
在 Agent 循环中运行的钩子会显示在这里。

让 Cursor 通过 Playwright MCP 查看日志和应用
You'll be logged out of your Cursor account on this device.
你将在此设备上退出 Cursor 账户。
Jump back to the Agents Window to keep working across repos.
返回 Agents 窗口以继续跨仓库工作。
Review the configuration before adding it to your MCP servers.
添加到 MCP 服务器之前请先检查配置。
Team admins can configure shared MCP servers in the dashboard.
团队管理员可在控制台中配置共享 MCP 服务器。
Choose the default behavior of messages sent while Agent is working
选择 Agent 工作时发送消息的默认行为
It'll be saved to Cursor Origin, so you can come back to it anytime.
它会保存到 Cursor Origin，你可以随时回来继续。
Add plugins or import from GitHub to make them available for your team.
添加插件或从 GitHub 导入，供团队使用。
Adjust the default behavior of sending a message while Agent is streaming
调整 Agent 流式输出时发送消息的默认行为
Add a personal cloud MCP server to make it available to your cloud agents.
添加个人云端 MCP 服务器，供云端 Agent 使用。
Allow agents on this machine to be controlled remotely from mobile and web
允许通过手机和网页远程控制此机器上的 Agent
Privacy Mode (Legacy) is enabled. Background Agent and some features not available.
已启用隐私模式（旧版）。后台 Agent 及部分功能不可用。
Agents can only belong to one group. Moving this agent will remove it from its current group.
Agent 只能属于一个分组。移动此 Agent 会把它从当前分组中移除。
Choose the default behavior of messages sent manually from the queue while Agent is streaming
选择 Agent 流式输出时从队列手动发送消息的默认行为
Allow agent to switch to modes without asking. When off, skips if unanswered within 15 seconds.
允许 Agent 在不问询的情况下切换模式。关闭后，若 15 秒内未回答则跳过。
Rules give Agent persistent, system-level instructions for your coding standards and workflows.
规则为 Agent 提供持久的系统级说明，用于你的编码标准和流程。
This track will silently download and install updates without prompting whenever Cursor is closed.
此通道会在 Cursor 关闭时静默下载并安装更新，不再弹出提示。
You don't have access to this agent's machine. The conversation and pull request are still available.
你无权访问此 Agent 的机器。对话和拉取请求仍可查看。
Bring over your chats, and send a follow-up to fork it. Your plugins and skills are synced by default.
带上你的对话并发送后续消息即可分叉。插件和技能默认会同步。
When data sharing is enabled, Cursor learns from code to help your team get the best experience possible.
启用数据共享后，Cursor 会从代码中学习，帮助团队获得更好的体验。
Several agent tasks are competing for system resources. Run fewer in parallel to keep your system responsive.
多个 Agent 任务正在争用系统资源。减少并行数量可保持系统流畅。
Allow agent to switch to modes like Plan or Debug without asking. When off, Cursor asks first, but skips if unanswered within 15 seconds.
允许 Agent 在不问询的情况下切换到计划或调试等模式。关闭后 Cursor 会先询问，但若 15 秒内未回答则跳过。
Your code data will not be trained on or used to improve the product. Code may be stored to provide features such as Background Agent.
你的代码数据不会用于训练或改进产品。代码可能会被存储，以便提供后台 Agent 等功能。
Add a custom MCP tool in your user MCP config or configure workspace-specific tools in <project-root>/.cursor/mcp.json.
在用户 MCP 配置中添加自定义 MCP 工具，或在 <project-root>/.cursor/mcp.json 中配置工作区专用工具。
只回答问题，不进行编辑
